method: Independent original mesh JSON enumeration and reconstructed original parameter support surfaces. Acceptance requires complete triangle containment in the two actual triangles of the original quad, coplanarity, complete z bounds and aligned outward normal. Height midpoint only selects candidate bins, never assigns material.
neutral_exclusions: Mixed unsegmented terrace mouth and inner/backing cuts
Unsplit roof cap, roof machinery and supports
Horizontal ledges, artificial ground and base
